structure: CSharp source-owned placement owner/lifetime/frame decisions map to the fourteen shared SLG placement providers. This registers their ownership phase responsibility separately from the existing type commitment and LLVM frame consumer decisions.
branches: Literal/repeat owners, readonly versus mutable/moved/escaping uses, nested/early-return liveness, strict slot reuse and growth,4096 admission, main/ordinary/inline/concrete function ownership and async inline-frame exclusion.
logic: Only nonescaping admitted owners enter stack frames. Readonly call recognition consumes canonical resolved declarations; lifetime spans the last enclosing source unit and actual interpolation use. Whole inline-frame admission preserves source owner identity and original byte counts. Rejected or overbudget valid owners keep ordinary heap semantics without partial plan mutation.
diagnostics: Checked source/index/unit/caller/pool/lookup integrity failures terminate S052. Ordinary ownership and S003 contracts remain unchanged. Existing related24 and placement32 focused evidence is retained; no parentC742, whole source or Stage closure.
